about: Hesitation sounds hush removes from every dictation, in code. 'universal' sounds are a word in no language and are always removed. 'languages' lists sounds that are a real word somewhere (German 'um' = at, Portuguese 'um' = a), removed only once the dictation's language is known. Add a language only with a source and benchmark cases in HushTests/Fixtures/Cleanup/filler-words.json.
